settings.title: Built to keep
settings.intro: We're not just another task list. Trellis is the operating system behind teams that ship on time, every time.

stats.label: Tasks completed in Trellis every day

settings.title: Plan the way your
settings.intro: Whether you run sprints, track a launch, or manage a client portfolio, Trellis adapts to your process — not the other way around.

design.title: Kanban boards
design.text: Drag cards across columns, set WIP limits, and see bottlenecks at a glance. Custom fields keep every card exactly as detailed as your team needs.

design.title: List & calendar views
design.text: Flip any board into a list, calendar, or table with one click. The same data, the view your team prefers.

build.title: Gantt timelines
build.text: Map dependencies, spot the critical path, and drag to reschedule. When a date slips, Trellis shows you exactly what it affects.

build.title: Sprint planning
build.text: Plan sprints from a shared backlog, estimate with story points, and track velocity across the whole team.

launch.title: Portfolio dashboards
launch.text: Roll up every project into one executive view. Spot at-risk work before it becomes a fire, and report progress in seconds.

launch.title: Resource planning
launch.text: See who's over-allocated and who has capacity. Balance the load across projects without the spreadsheet gymnastics.

settings.title: From signup to shipped in
settings.intro: Trellis is designed to be adopted in an afternoon, not rolled out over a quarter. Here's how a typical team gets going.

steps.title: Create your workspace
steps.text: Sign up free and invite your team. Trellis auto-creates a starter board so you can see the value before you configure anything.

steps.title: Import your work
steps.text: Bring in existing projects from spreadsheets, other tools, or a blank slate. Our importer maps your columns in minutes.

steps.title: Build your workflow
steps.text: Set up statuses, custom fields, and automations that match how your team already works. No rigid templates to fight.

steps.title: Ship and scale
steps.text: Add timelines, portfolios, and reporting as your team grows. Trellis scales from a two-person startup to a 300-person org.

settings.note: Most teams are running their real work in Trellis within the first hour — no training sessions, no consultants required.

settings.title: The workspace your
settings.intro: Plenty of tools look good in a demo. Trellis is built for the messy, real-world way teams work — and it shows up in the details.

features.title: Fast by default
features.text: Every action is instant, even on huge boards. No waiting for the spinner between drags, comments, or status changes.

features.title: Automations that just work
features.text: Set rules like 'when a card moves to Done, notify the client' without writing a line of code. Trigger actions across your whole workspace.

features.title: Real-time collaboration
features.text: See teammates' cursors, comments, and edits live. Async or in-sync, everyone is always on the same page.

features.title: Powerful search
features.text: Find any task, comment, or file across every project in seconds. Saved views keep your most-used filters one click away.

features.title: Integrations that connect
features.text: Two-way sync with Slack, GitHub, Google Drive, and 80+ tools. Your work stays in Trellis, your tools stay connected.

features.title: Enterprise-grade security
features.text: SSO, SCIM, granular permissions, and audit logs. SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant out of the box.

settings.title: Questions teams
settings.intro: Straight answers about migration, pricing, and what moving to Trellis actually takes.

items.question: How long does it take to migrate from our current tool?
items.answer: Most teams import their projects and are up and running in under an hour. Our importer maps columns, assignees, and due dates automatically, and our team is on hand to help with anything tricky.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: Yes. Trellis is SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and Business plans add SSO, SCIM, and audit logs for full control.

items.question: Can we really use it free forever?
items.answer: Yes. The Free plan supports up to 10 users with unlimited boards and tasks, and it's genuinely free — no trial clock, no credit card. Upgrade only when your team outgrows it.

items.question: Does Trellis work for non-technical teams?
items.answer: Absolutely. Marketing, HR, operations, and design teams use Trellis every day. The interface is intuitive, and automations let anyone build powerful workflows without code.

items.question: What happens if we need more than the Business plan?
items.answer: We offer custom Enterprise plans with volume pricing, dedicated infrastructure options, and a named success manager. Talk to our sales team and we'll build a plan around your needs.

settings.title: Let's get your team
settings.intro: Start free in minutes, or talk to our team about migrating, enterprise plans, or a custom rollout. We'll get back to you the same day.
